page_title: SEV 1-0 PAL | Sevilla v Las Palmas 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Juan Martinez Munuera has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
90+6' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+6' Neat passing move from Las Palmas in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90+4' Las Palmas work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

90+4' Marko Dmitrovic pulls off a great save to deny Javier Munoz (Las Palmas), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal. The ball is out of play and Las Palmas manage to earn a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

89' Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
85' Substitution. Erik Lamela (Sevilla) on for Lucas Ocampos.
85' Substitution. Oliver Torres makes way for Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla).
85' Here is a change. Kirian is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Javier Munoz (Las Palmas).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pejino (Las Palmas) is coming onto the pitch as Munir El Haddadi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' A rebound falls to Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post.

84' A sweet pass finds Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Alvaro Valles is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
83' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) is flagged for offside.
82' Flag goes up against Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
80' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is able to continue to play.
79' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) picks up an injury.

76' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) bursts into the penalty area with the ball at his feet after a wonderful individual effort that left fans breathless and in awe. However, he sends the ball in a completely different direction than intended, well wide of the target. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
76' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Las Palmas.
75' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way. It will be a corner kick for Las Palmas.
75' Las Palmas quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
75' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Now Las Palmas have a corner.
74' Here's the change. Djibril Sow leaves the pitch and Fernando (Sevilla) comes on as a substitute.
73' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) replaces Enzo Loiodice.
73' That's the end of the game for Alex Suarez, who is replaced by Marvin (Las Palmas).
71' 1 - 0 Goal! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
71' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Alvaro Valles, who pulls off a stunning save!
69' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
69' The Sevilla players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Juan Martinez Munuera signals NO GOAL following the VAR review.
69' Sevilla score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.

68' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Alvaro Valles anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
66' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) gets a nice pass from Djibril Sow on the edge of the box, he looks up and tries to beat the keeper in the corner but it goes just wide of the right post.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Julian Araujo will be replaced by Saul Coco (Las Palmas).
63' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Oliver Torres (Sevilla) heads on.
63' Although Pejino (Las Palmas) is just on the bench, Juan Martinez Munuera has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
62' Juan Martinez Munuera shows a yellow card to Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) for his blatant foul.
61' Jose Luis Mendilibar decides to make a substitution. Rafa Mir will be replaced by Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla).
61' Substitution. Suso will be replaced by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla).

61' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.

59' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the right side of the goal, but Alvaro Valles made an astonishing save!

58' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
55' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
55' Suso (Sevilla) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sevilla.
54' PENALTY APPEAL after Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
52' That's a clear yellow card. Kirian (Las Palmas) goes into the book.
51' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
50' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the corner which is cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sevilla are going to take it.
50' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall. The referee blows his whistle, Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
49' Sevilla have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Juan Martinez Munuera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!

48' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the right side of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic shows his agility and makes a save.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Suso (Sevilla) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
45+5' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Martinez Munuera had an easy-decision to make.
45+5' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul after Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick is awarded to Sevilla.
45+3' An attempted cross from Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is cleared.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
44' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
44' Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
42' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for an infringement.
41' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Jesus Navas (Sevilla) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
38' Sevilla take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
38' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
36' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
35' Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

34' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sevilla.
32' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
27' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
25' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
22' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Juan Martinez Munuera stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
21' Loic Bade (Sevilla) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
19' Loic Bade (Sevilla) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
18' Loic Bade (Sevilla) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Martinez Munuera blows for a foul.
16' Ooh that was close! Kirian (Las Palmas) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.

15' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Martinez Munuera blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
14' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
11' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
9' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his effort from near the penalty spot towards the right post is saved by the goalkeeper.
7' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

7' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the top left corner. Alvaro Valles pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
5' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
4' The linesman raises his flag. Suso (Sevilla) is adjudged offside.
1' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Las Palmas will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Juan Martinez Munuera.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
